title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse | TechCrunch
summary: Once a customer makes a request in Muse, the assistant sends it to Walmart, which returns relevant products and helps build a shopping cart. For instance, Muse doesn’t get access to a customer’s Walmart shopping history or other personal information.
